name: Database access restriction
description: PC-1 tries to open TCP/3306 on DB-SRV. CORE-SW1 denies it with STAFF-IN rule 10.

presentation.objective: Show that staff cannot reach the database directly.
presentation.security_rule: STAFF-IN rule 10: deny tcp 10.0.10.0/24 to 10.0.30.20 port 3306 (enforced by CORE-SW1).
presentation.explanation: The SYN is dropped at CORE-SW1 before it can reach the server VLAN, so the connection never opens and the rule counter rises.
expected: The SYN is dropped at CORE-SW1 by STAFF-IN:10
The packet never reaches IPS-1 or DB-SRV
The SIEM receives a CORE-SW1 enforcement event
